env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A use that sorts before the defining file reads the same const composite.
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ccorder

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok exported-read 1
ok exported-copy-isolated 1
ok exported-alias-isolated 2
ok unexported-read 1
ok unexported-copy-isolated 1
ok unexported-alias-isolated 2
ok scalar 7
-- m/a.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("ok exported-read", Cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	c := Cfg
	c.M["a"] = 9
	fmt.Println("ok exported-copy-isolated", Cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	m := Cfg.M
	m["b"] = 77
	fmt.Println("ok exported-alias-isolated", Cfg.M["b"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-read", cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	d := cfg
	d.M["a"] = 9
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-copy-isolated", cfg.M["a"] ?? -1)
	n := cfg.M
	n["b"] = 77
	fmt.Println("ok unexported-alias-isolated", cfg.M["b"] ?? -1)
	fmt.Println("ok scalar", cfg.N)
}
-- m/b.lgo --
package main

type box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const Cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

const cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}
